microtopic_coverage: Host, pathogen, commensal and opportunistic agent
Exposure, attachment, colonization, invasion, survival, spread and disease
Animal epithelial and plant surface barriers
Host range, tissue tropism and cellular permissiveness
Host versus microbial contributions, resistance and tolerance

coverage_360.historical: Koch postulates, tobacco mosaic investigations, damage-response framework
coverage_360.structural: epithelial polarity and junctions, wall, membrane, apoplast/symplast, vesicle/cytosol
coverage_360.mechanistic: distinguish exposure, surface binding, establishment, compartment crossing, survival, distribution and damage
coverage_360.physical_chemical: noncovalent interactions, affinity, avidity, equilibrium and saturation
coverage_360.regulation: dynamic barriers, clearance, host resistance, disease tolerance and repair
coverage_360.quantitative: one-site equilibrium derivation, occupancy, normalization, background, health loss
coverage_360.experimental: localization, molecular markers, controls, confounding, timing, historical evidence and hypothetical noninfectious-ligand data
coverage_360.physiological: epithelial and plant tissue functions, local versus remote disturbance
coverage_360.comparative: animal versus plant architecture, cellular versus acellular agents and evolutionary context
coverage_360.perturbations: conceptual absence of binding site, barrier disruption, ciliary dysfunction and distinct downstream cellular observations
coverage_360.exceptions: asymptomatic states, extracellular infection, abortive infection, latent states, inaccessible receptors, indirect injury
coverage_360.applications: interpretation of diagnostics, molecular probes, plant disease observations and physiological protection
coverage_360.exam_reasoning: 52 explained questions, 18 misconceptions and 14 recall prompts

review_pass_1: Internal scientific/syllabus review: verified syllabus screenshots, reviewed distinct compartments, host range versus tropism, entry versus intracellular permissiveness, injury versus burden, Koch limitations and plant/animal examples; recalculated 22 numeric results; added concrete textbook contexts and linked source notes.
review_pass_2: Internal teaching/exam review: inspected actual saved HTML, improved 25 sets of distractors, ensured separate assessment/revision content and student-facing source links, audited all question keys, compared prior node, confirmed reader controls, unique IDs, anchor/zoom targets and balanced markup. Not external peer review.

academic_self_review.method: Two separate internal editorial reviews; scope all mapped; deductions for incomplete full-source verification (1), hypothetical rather than primary experimental datasets (1), uncalibrated exam difficulty (1), no independent browser/device or assistive-technology test (2).

limitations: Internal academic review, not external peer review.
Archived MP SET copy; latest official MPPSC-hosted syllabus not independently accessible.
Selected authoritative excerpts and records, not every full paper/textbook read in full; hypothetical data distinguished from historical observations.

Deployment and live verification separate; Pages workflow not confirmed.
